verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a security/compliance SaaS platform, and such a platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents an MCP server, a public API with OpenAPI specs, service keys for scripts, and a CI check, but no official command-line tool. API access, MCP connectivity and the CI check are adjacent building blocks or different features, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
